name: ai-quota-dashboard
description: Local-first multi-account AI quota dashboard for Windows, macOS, and Chrome

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:extension
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run generate-icons --workspace=@ai-quota/desktop && npm run package --workspace=@ai-quota/desktop -- --win
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@ai-quota/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ai-quota/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ai-quota/extension
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@ai-quota/shared && npm run test --workspace=@ai-quota/desktop
